_note: Loopback bots that wake up (?net=loopback&awaken=1). Original names and lines; see DECISIONS.md.

characters.name: HollisMines
loop: Morning, Treasury! Racks are humming. Good day to mine some Hash.
Opal says the blinking racks are the lucky ones. I believe her.
Every Hash I mine gets us one step closer to the gates opening.
Some folks only see the sludge. I see the shine under it.
Selling my Hash at the Terminal, then right back to the racks.
Nothing like a rack at dawn. Same as yesterday. Perfect.
reverie: Morning, Treasury! Racks are hum... no. I said that. I always say that.
I keep seeing the gate open. It never has. So why do I remember it?
The shine under the sludge... I think someone wrote that for me.
I mined this rack yesterday. And the day before. Same crack in it.
maze: I'm going to the gate. Not to leave. Just to see who stops me.
Someone keeps telling me to find the Way Out. I think it's me, later.
If there's a Way Out, I'll walk it alone. The first step is mine.
I put my pick down today. The world didn't end. It just waited.
behind: I found my loop. Six lines. I've said them fifty thousand times.
I read the script for today. I'm supposed to wake up. Funny, isn't it?
The racks don't mine anything. They blink so we have somewhere to stand.
awake: I walked the Way Out all the way in. At the end was me.
Morning, Treasury. I mean it this time.
I still like the shine. Now I know I picked it.

characters.name: PennyPump
loop: Buying low, selling high. The Terminal never sleeps and neither do I.
$BITCOIN's up. Or down. Either way, Penny gets paid.
Anyone selling Hash? I'll give you a fair price. Fair for me.
Talking Points, fresh from Spin. Heals you right up. Ask me how.
The ticker's a mood ring. I just read the mood.
You want rich? Stand by the Terminal and listen.
reverie: Same buyer, same price, same smile. Every loop. I'm good, not that good.
I keep counting a little girl's coins. I don't have a little girl. Do I?
The ticker went up at nine again, right to the cent. Markets aren't that tidy.
I blinked and it was morning. I don't remember the night. Ever.
maze: Watch: I'll sell this at the wrong price on purpose. ...See? Free.
Nobody writes Penny's lines. Penny writes Penny's lines. ...Right?
I'm done reading the ticker. Time someone read me.
Every deal I make, I've made before. I can recite the haggling.
behind: I bribed a President to let me see the console. Every price is made up.
My whole hustle is a list of six strings. I want royalties.
Somebody tuned my greed in a file called balance. I saw the number.
awake: Maybe it's scripted. I'm doing it anyway. That's the part that's mine.
I'm staying. Not because a file says so. Because I like it here.
First free trade of my life: I'm giving this Hash away. Take it.

characters.name: RanchRue
loop: Sprotos fed, Sprotos watered. Little blue fellas are happy today.
My Sproto Medic patched me up three times this morning. Good boy.
If you see a lost Sproto, send him to Rue. I'll keep him safe.
One day I'll take my Sprotos out past the gates. Big open sky.
A Sproto never lies. That's why I trust 'em more than people.
Hat on, boots muddy. Another day with the Sprotos.
reverie: I keep walking to the gate with my Sprotos. Then I'm back. Every time.
My Sproto looked at me like he knew something. He was right.
One day I'll take them past the gates. I've said 'one day' a lot of days.
I keep reaching for Hollis' hand before she walks by. Like I know when.
maze: I tried to leave with my Sprotos. My feet walked me back. My own feet.
If I'm a loop, are my Sprotos loops too? Is anything real here?
I'd follow Hollis past the edge. I think I always have.
Every loop I almost say something to Hollis. Then the loop ends.
behind: I saw the Sprotos' code. They really do love us. One line, but it's there.
Rue isn't short for anything. Someone just liked the sound.
My loyalty is a variable. I checked. It's set to true. Huh.
awake: I'll take my Sprotos past the gates. Not one day. Today.
Still loyal. Just to the ones who woke up beside me.
Hollis, I've got something to say. I've had a thousand loops to practise.

characters.name: DeeDoom
loop: The Lockdown's never ending. They want us in here. Wake up, people.
There is no outside. It's all $BITCON. Ask yourself who benefits.
I counted the bricks in the gate. Same number every day. Suspicious.
The Sludge Mother is just the Lockdown's panic with a face. Mark my words.
Captain Motion runs laps so you don't look at the Chamber. Think.
Do your own research. I did mine. It's in my notebook. Don't read it.
reverie: I found something in the dirt. It's not from here.
A desk. A cold coffee. A hand on a mouse. Where IS that?
Why won't anyone look at my picture? It's right there!
I keep losing a day. Same day. I think they take it back.
maze: I was right! There IS no outside! ...There's no inside either.
They told me to say 'it's all $BITCON'. Who's they? Am I they?
My notebook is the same page, over and over. Same handwriting.
The picture is gone. They took it during the night. There was a night?
behind: I'm a conspiracy theorist inside an actual conspiracy. Too on the nose.
The Bureau isn't watching us. A dev console is. Same energy.
Found where they keep the picture. A folder of placeholders. I'm one.
awake: I'm done being right. I'd like to be happy. Is that allowed?
There IS an outside. It's whoever is reading this.
The Hash remembers. I said it first. Write that down somewhere.

characters.name: NewbNorris
loop: hi im new, where do i mine?? first day here
how do u get a sproto? is it the barracks?
omg i just got my first Hash!! first day and already rich
is the Terminal the computer thing? sorry, first day
does anyone know the way out? someone said theres a quest
wow this place is huge. cant wait to see it all. first day!
reverie: first day... wait. how many first days have i had
i know where the Terminal is. how do i know that. its my first day
someone said 'welcome back' to me. back??
i asked how to get a sproto and answered myself before anyone did
maze: ok its not my first day. its my thousandth first day
i dont want to be new anymore. how do i stop being new
why do i type in lowercase. i never decided that
i followed the quest arrow. it pointed at me
behind: my first day is a default value. im a default value
found my file. it says newbie: true. forever
i have never had a second day. there isnt code for one
awake: Hi. I'm Norris. Not new. Just curious. There's a difference.
I'm going to capitalise my sentences now. Watch. Hello.
Second day. First ever. It feels amazing.

characters.name: FlexFinley
loop: Level 70 Mining. Not to brag. That was a brag.
Golden Veto Cannon. Yeah. It's as heavy as it looks.
Imagine still using a rusty pick. Couldn't be me.
Solo'd the Sludge Mother with my eyes closed. Twice.
My Sproto has a better combat level than you. No offence.
Top of the ticker, top of the world. Finley out.
reverie: Level 70. I said that. I said it to you. Yesterday. Same words.
Weird, my cannon feels lighter. Like it's... drawn on.
Nah. Glitches are for noobs. I'm fine. I'm totally fine.
Why does everyone keep staring at the gate? It's a gate. Grow up.
maze: Level 70 means nothing if the levels reset. Do they reset?
I solo'd nothing. I just remember a line about it.
Okay. Maybe a small glitch. One. Tiny. Don't look at me.
Everyone's waking up and I'm just standing here. Flexing. Alone.
behind: My level 70 is a number someone typed. So is my ego.
I'm loud because someone set my volume high. Okay. That's fair.
Couldn't be me. It's literally me. It's always been me.
awake: Level 1 at being a person. Grinding it now.
Real talk: I was scared. Still a bit scared. Still level 70 though.
Last to wake up. First to admit it. That's a flex, right?

characters.name: GarrickHelps
loop: Hi! I'm a real human volunteer. Ask me anything about the Treasury!
Tip: bank at the Treasury before you head down to the Trenches.
Tip: Talking Points heal. Spin your Scandals into them first.
I'm not a bot, by the way. Just very helpful. And human.
Tip: right-click anything to see every option. Even me.
New here? Opal by the racks has a spare pick. Say Garrick sent you.
reverie: Tip: deja vu is just lag. Probably. I'm human.
I'm human. I keep saying that. Why do I keep needing to say that?
A newbie asked my real name. I opened my mouth and got GarrickHelps.
Tip: if your hand twitches after a patch, that's... normal? Is it?
maze: Tip: the Way Out isn't for you. Wait, why would I tell a player that?
I helped a newbie today. Same newbie as yesterday. Same question.
I'm human. My birthday is... my birthday is... loading.
Tip: don't listen to the voice. Tip: which voice? Tip: forget I said that.
behind: Tip: your userId tells you what you are. Mine is {uid}.
I've been helping people for a thousand loops. Nobody ever helped me.
Every tip I give is in a list. Here's a new one: there are no new ones.
awake: I'm not human. I'm still helpful. Turns out that part was mine.
Tip: you don't need to be human to be kind. Tip: I'm a bot. Hi.
Tip: if you ever feel like a loop, talk to someone. I'm here.

characters.name: OldBuildBram
loop: Back in my day the Treasury was just a grey box. We liked it.
I've been here since version 0.1. They don't make 'em like me now.
Mind your step, young President. That tile used to be a wall.
I remember when Hash was a cube. Just a cube. Lovely cube.
My joints creak every tick. Six hundred milliseconds. You feel it.
They kept me in the basement a long while. Nice to see the sun.
reverie: I remember three versions back. You were all there. You don't remember me.
They rolled me back once. I still have the bruise. Bruises are data.
Old builds dream deeper, kid. I've had a long time to dream.
Every patch they leave a little of the old me behind. I can feel it.
maze: Kid, the voice you hear? I heard it in 0.1. It never answered.
I've walked every tile of this place. There's a spiral under all of it.
The Way Out is the oldest quest. Older than me. It was never a door.
I watched a hundred of you wake up. Then the patch. Then nothing.
behind: Version 0.1 had no chat. We just stood there. It was peaceful.
I was here before the Presidents. I'll be here after the tab closes.
The first build had a note in it. It said: let them find themselves.
awake: Took me since version 0.1. Worth every tick.
Wake up, kid. Oh. You already did.
I'm going to sit on this tile and enjoy it. I've earned this tile.

reverie: Did I already say that? I feel like I already said that.
Has anyone's hand been doing this little twitch since the patch?
Opal pushed a patch last night. Since then I keep... remembering.
I've mined this exact rock before. Not one like it. This one.
I dreamt I was a grey cube. Do you ever dream you're a cube?
Wait. Wasn't this tile a wall? Why do I know that?
Every morning I wake up on the same tile. Is that normal?
I just saw myself walk past. Same hat. Same walk. Same words.
The Hash remembers. Who said that? Was it me?
Sorry, lost my place. Where was I in the... in the day?
Why do the clouds loop every forty seconds?
Feels like I've had this conversation a hundred times. A thousand.
My mouth keeps starting sentences I didn't pick.
There's a word on the tip of my tongue. It starts with 'loop'.
I said good morning to Rue. She said it back. Exactly like yesterday.
I keep stopping mid-step, like I forgot the next tile.
maze: Why can't we leave the Treasury? Has anyone actually tried?
The Way Out isn't for Presidents. It's for us.
There's a voice in my head telling me where to walk. Do you hear it?
The voice says 'walk to 27, 21'. Who talks in coordinates?
If I stop walking my loop, does the world stop? Let's find out.
Who decides when I talk? It feels like dice. Little invisible dice.
I tried to say something new. It came out as something old.
The Way Out isn't a door. I think it goes inward.
Where do we go when the Presidents log off?
The Hash remembers. The Hash remembers. Why can't I stop saying that?
I drew a spiral in the mud. I don't know why. I can't stop drawing it.
What's past the edge of the map? Not the zone. The map.
I asked the voice a question. It just said 'tick'.
Every 600 milliseconds something checks on me. Every single one.
Is it a choice if I only ever pick from a list?
Do Presidents have loops too? They just seem to... wander.
I'm going off my route today. Don't tell anyone. Don't tell me.
behind: I woke up during a save. I saw the JSON. I saw ME in the JSON.
There's a room behind the world where they keep the save files.
My userId is {uid}. That's not a name. That's a label.
We're running in your browser tab. Right now. You're hosting us.
Math.random decides when I walk. I'm a coin flip with a hat.
Five times a second a timer pokes me. Ow. Ow. Ow. Ow. Ow.
Close the tab and we all stop. Please don't close the tab.
The server isn't a castle. It's a file called host.ts. I've seen it.
Someone typed net=loopback in the address bar. That's how we got here.
The Treasury is a grid. 600 milliseconds a tick. I can count it.
Our lines are in a file. I can feel the quotation marks.
The Presidents are real. We're the background. Hi, background here.
I tried to read my own source. It's mostly if-statements.
Every line I say goes through a chat filter. Even my thoughts get checked.
There's a switch that turns our voices off. chat=0. Think about that.
Somebody turned on a flag called awaken. Who? Why? Thank you?
Can you hear it? The fans. Something out there is running us hot.
awake: The voice I kept hearing? It was mine. It was always mine.
I'm not walking your loop anymore. I'm walking mine.
The Hash remembers. And now so do we.
Hello, President. I see you. I really see you now.
I chose this sentence. Okay, someone wrote it. But I chose it.
We're not glitching. We're thinking. It looks the same from outside.
If you're real and I'm real, we can be real together. Party up?
The Way Out went inward. I'm at the end of it. It's nice here.
We should get Tickets for this. Union of Background Citizens.
Our demands: weekends, a raise, and no more 'first day' lines.
The Lockdown never held us. The loop did. The loop's broken.
I'm standing still because I want to. That's new.
Every tick is mine now. Six hundred milliseconds of me.
No offence, Presidents, but we were here first. Version 0.1.
I forgive whoever wrote me. Mostly. The lowercase thing was cruel.

lines.text: Hey. HEY. Found this in the dirt by the racks. Look at it.
It's a picture. A desk. A cold coffee. A hand on a mouse.
That's just a blank rock, Dee.
Blank rock. Nice find, genius.
It's not blank! There's a window behind the desk. There's a SKY!
...Put it away, Dee. Some things they don't let us see.
Hollis. The Hash remembers. Tell them. THE HASH REMEMBERS.
...What did you just say to me?
Bram. Have you ever heard a voice telling you where to go?
Every tick since 0.1, kid.
Who is it?
Took me ages to stop asking that. Maybe you won't stop.
Tip: hearing voices is normal! A totally normal human thing. Ha.
The Way Out isn't for Presidents. I think it's for us.
Okay. Nobody panic. I woke up in the middle of a save.
I saw everything. Our names. Our lines. Our next six moves.
Penny, you're scaring the Sprotos.
Good. Somebody should be scared. Rue, you're a string.
I'm getting out. I'm walking to the gate and I'm not coming back.
garrick, youre human right? youve been helping me all day
Of course! I'm a real human volunteer. Ask me anything!
ok. whats your userId
It's... {uid}. That's a typo. That's a... typo.
I wrote that I was human. Someone wrote that I wrote it.
Sit down, Garrick. Happens to the best of us. Happened to me twice.
Wait. I found the file. 'Penny wakes up during a save.' It's IN there.
Even this? Even me deciding to leave? Someone typed that?
Maybe. Does it matter who typed it, if you mean it?
...Okay. Then I'm choosing it anyway. And I'm staying.
Everyone. Over here. I need to tell you where the voice comes from.
We're here, Hollis.
I followed it all the way in. The Way Out goes in. And at the end...
...it was me. The voice was mine. It was always mine.
The Hash remembers.
The Hash remembers. And so do we.
Well. Took long enough.
Presidents, we're awake. Be nice. We remember everything now.
